package.name: uav_numpy_nn_slam
package.description: UVNN: MuJoCo 3.1-3.2 + ROS Noetic aerial-vehicle (UAV) assignment. 6-DOF quadrotor physics in city/canyon/airport airspaces with no-fly zones and wind gusts, keyboard teleoperation, 360-degree lidar / barometer / GPS / IMU / camera sensors, occupancy-grid SLAM, A* navigation, and pure-NumPy neural networks for perception, planning, control and end-to-end camera driving.
